findings.title: The fixed connection in the proposed deformation is not Yang-Mills
findings.proof: For the actual orthonormal frame, Koszul contraction gives Ric(T,W1)=2kf/(1+k^2)^2*(1/(a^3*b^4)-a). At k=1,a=1,b=1/2,f=1/10 this is 3/4, contradicting (74)-(75). For k nonzero Yang-Mills requires ab=1. Round quotient fibers require b=1/(1+k^2), forcing a=1+k^2 and Ric_N(X2,X2)=4-2k^2<0 for |k|>=2 within this ansatz. The printed monotonicity b'>=0 is independently incompatible with its endpoints.
findings.counterevidence: The k=1 example has positive full Ricci matrix; nonzero mixed Ricci does not by itself force negativity. No impossibility of alternative paths or of the main theorem is claimed.
findings.core_dependency: Lemma 6.3 -> harmonic matching Section 6.6 -> Theorem 6.1 -> Lemma 7.2/Proposition 7.1 -> Theorem 1.1
findings.repair: A different connection/path construction or controlled transition is needed; merely correcting the bracket index or b monotonicity does not fix the harmonic matching.

findings.title: The tangential neck Ricci formula omits g''
findings.proof: For h=1 and g(r)=exp(2c(r-1)^2)gS3 + exp(-2c(r-1)^2)gS3, the volume form is constant. At r=1, g'=0 and the actual first-sphere Ricci is 2-2c, whereas (128) gives 2. The missing tensor term is -h^2*g''/2. The shape-operator derivation of the complete tangential identity is in report (R5).
findings.counterevidence: This tests the asserted general formula, not the particular final neck. Slow reparametrization and a second derivative bound could repair an estimate; no verified replacement constants are claimed.
findings.repair: Bound both dot(gtilde) and ddot(gtilde), retain g''=ddot(gtilde)*(t')^2+dot(gtilde)*t'', and re-establish the simultaneous positivity bounds.

findings.title: Incorrect volume normalization and unnormalized Moser density
findings.proof: For a tensor factor A in dimension six, Vol(A*g)=A^3 Vol(g). A=tilde_a*Vol(g)^(-1/6) leaves volume tilde_a^3 Vol(g)^(1/2). The density is then explicitly set to dv(ghat), also not normalized. Weighted integration of (120) forces d/dr int(nu)=0, which fails for ghat=c(r)g0 with a nonconstant positive interior bump and constant endpoints.
findings.counterevidence: Use tensor exponent -1/3 and the volume form of the normalized tensor, or consistently square a length factor. This repairs the integration obstruction but not F01/F02.
findings.core_dependency: Lemma 7.2(3) -> constant-volume neck computation -> Proposition 7.1 -> Theorem 1.1
findings.repair: Correct normalization and density, then perform the equivariant weighted elliptic/Moser argument.

findings.title: Coprime weights alone do not imply freeness on S3 x R4
findings.proof: Weights (2,1) satisfy coprimality and a nonzero, but theta=pi fixes every (u,0). Stabilizer at the zero section has order |a|.
findings.counterevidence: Actual construction uses (1,k), and is free. The generic nonzero-R4 locus has trivial stabilizer when weights are coprime.
findings.core_dependency: The overgeneral condition is not needed by the actual induction.
findings.repair: Require |a|=1 for this global product-model assertion.

findings.title: Universal metric-cone claim conflicts with stated cylindrical blow-down
findings.proof: R3 x S1 has fundamental group Z, whereas a full metric cone is contractible by radial contraction. The k_j->infinity limit in (22) cannot also be a metric cone.
findings.counterevidence: Bounded-index subsequences avoid this particular limit; no geometric obstruction to the main inductive construction is established.
findings.repair: Restrict the cone assertion and distinguish general pointed blow-down limits.

findings.title: Orientation-reversing mapping classes are omitted
findings.proof: The swap sigma(x,y)=(y,x) acts on H3 by [[0,1],[1,0]] with determinant -1, outside SL(2,Z).
findings.counterevidence: Sigma is an isometry of the equal-sphere product. For orientation-reversing phi, psi=sigma o phi preserves orientation and psi*g0=phi*g0, so the intended path conclusion reduces to the orientation-preserving case.
findings.core_dependency: Does not independently obstruct Lemma 1.2 once the orientation-preserving path exists.
findings.repair: State the mapping-class structure for Diff+ and add the isometric swap reduction.
